column10: Product title and five-control layout are useful external identifiers; preserve as a distinct model rather than folding into other Funny Little Boxes gain pedals.

column7: Dual-circuit pedal combining the Demon and Lil Fella circuits with gate and feedback functions.

column10: MK2/Extended naming is an explicit generation marker; clipping selector and mid-boost are external identification clues.

column7: JHS's first original modern distortion design rather than a direct recreation of a classic pedal, developed over eight years and completed as the final design project of former lead engineer Cliff Smith.
column10: The model's original-design status, sweepable midrange and six-knob layout are core product identity fields.

column10: Preserve Gehenna as its own Lichtlaerm product identity and distinguish it from the builder's other metal designs.

column10: The builder explicitly identifies Medusa as the successor to Breathe//Die, making lineage a major identification field.

column7: Extended-range Rat-style distortion included in GPX's 2024 distortion field.
column10: Preserve punctuation in the model name exactly; the unusual naming is itself a useful catalog identifier.

column10: Track the current V.III separately from earlier MenaWatt production; top-mounted jacks and added Power Gain/Presence are version clues.

column10: The 1992 name, UAFX dual-engine platform, integrated noise gate and built-in overdrive/boost make this a distinct digital product identity.

column7: UAFX amplifier emulator announced October 22, 2024, modeling the Rev F Dual Rectifier with three channels, built-in overdrive/boost, noise gate and cab/mic modeling.
